title: Mass Effect Apex simulator reference dataset
integration_status: Reference data for adaptation; no existing simulator code was provided or modified.

evidence_policy.canon: Only explicitly labelled canon fields claim released-game support.
evidence_policy.au_lock: Inherited user continuity or accepted working number.
evidence_policy.au_proposal: New implementation detail or reconciled count.
evidence_policy.sim: Tunable gameplay value, not a measured physical quantity.
evidence_policy.derived: Arithmetic from stated inputs; inherits their uncertainty.
evidence_policy.unknown: Use JSON null; never substitute a convenient lore number.

readiness_distribution.warning: Execution weights alter readiness and handling, not the physical yield of an identical gun.

retrofit_allocation.rule: Allocate actual variants before spawning. Fractions are proposals; no automatic universal upgrade.

hades_penetrator.space_effect: Directional coupling, radiation and fragments; no atmospheric blast sphere.

legacy_nova.warning: Canon does not establish the power, recoil or field solution. 0.1c is the numerical example, not a claim of literal near-c velocity.

arithmetic_examples.warning: Ordinary rest-mass examples only. Effective mass and FTL energy coupling are unknown.

tactical_model.projectile_resolution: analytic interception or adaptive substeps, not endpoint-only overlap
tactical_model.reference_calibration: All hits, synchronised volleys, no return fire or manoeuvre, fixed kinetic DKE packets. This calibrates shields only.

sensitivity_axes.conservation_rule: Changing Alpha losses or Sol commitment requires recomputing post-Alpha inventory and active-elsewhere counts. Do not add reinforcements from nowhere.
